134864.overview: Inspired in the game of GBA

134865.overview: Dragon Ball Z: Attack of the Saiyans is an OpenBOR beat 'em up released in 2017. The game tells the story of Goku's father, Bardock, and of the final days in the life of planet Vegeta. With sharp graphics and cutscenes, fast gameplay and responsive controls, the game is a well-polished entry into the OpenBOR library.

142541.overview: The man of your dreams is back and this time in, full on, 16-bit glory. Fight through an army of Freddy's past victims, hellish nightmares, and Krueger himself as one of the Dream Warriors. Do you have what it takes?

185670.overview:
A new enemy has summoned evil and killed all of the heroes! Discover the world of Greyhawk and stop Iuz's campaign to conquer the Kingdom of Furyondy! Undertake daring missions to rescue allies, sabotage enemy strongholds and find the secret to defeating this threat once and for all!

Created by Counte Monte on the OpenBOR engine, Dungeons and Dragons: The Rise of Warduke is not just a button-mashing beat 'em up but mixes in a bit of role-playing adventure as you visit towns across the map, talk to NPC's and fight random encounters. There are 13 playable characters, some of whom must be unlocked like dark elves and necromancers, who can learn dozens of spells, buy weapons and equipment, complete quests, hire mercenaries, solve puzzles and traps, find secret dungeons, joust for prizes, and much more!

190392.overview: A fanmade OpenBor version of the CAPCOM arcade classic.

192534.overview: The Japanese author, Shin, has seen fit to revisit the Guardians / Denjin Makai saga of Banpresto calling as protagonists some characters seen in that of Street Fighter Zero. The result is a fun scrolling fighting game where we can go around the streets with Ryu, Cody, Sagat (and not only) to break a little bit of everything that moves (and of course also what doesn't move, as always).

203056.overview:
Start an epic journey in a land full of mystery and adventure! Explore the realm of Karameikos, complete the quests scattered across the map, find new friends that will join in your travels, and unveil the mystery under the monsters' invasion!

• New & improved level-up system! as you level up, you will gain health points, magic points and new exciting special moves for all the characters!
• New game modes! Unlock the Endless Quest with all the characters available from the start! Or put yourself to the test with the new Arcade Quests, where you start at level 20 from the beginning, and face all the quests without break, in a classic arcade battle that will leave you breathless!
• New block system! Now you have an appropriate button to defend yourself!
• New recover system! When knocked down, press the jump button and the directional controls repeatedly to stand up immediately and crush your enemies!
• up to 4 players can play together! Can you survive in this perilous lands by yourself, or you'll face the threats with your trusted fellowship?
• tons of treasures, monsters and DRAGONS!

Knights and Dragons: The Endless Quest is a beat 'em up in the style of old tabletop games. Thanks to the OpenBor engine and tons of material taken directly from old Dungeons and Dragons titles, it provides as close to a classic role-playing game experience as you can get.

Players can choose between various classes of characters: warrior, cleric, mage, archer, dwarf, and thief. One to four players can participate using Xbox 360 controllers and the keyboard.

Once you've chosen your characters, the adventure begins. Your characters start with a very limited amount of life points, which you can increase as you gain levels. So be careful, because at the start of the adventure, your characters can die after just one or two hits.

Just like in Dungeons and Dragons, you can choose which missions you want to play. There are lots of different options, and each will reward you handsomely if you are able to complete it. Of course, if all of your characters die, it's game over.

Once you finish Knights and Dragons, you'll gain access to additional playing modes, with all the characters unlocked and a few extra surprises.

Knights and Dragons: The Endless Quest is one of the best beat 'em ups based in the Dungeons and Dragons franchise that you'll find. It offers a dozen hours of classic action, difficult enough to provide a real challenge.

204903.overview:
Dungeons & Dragons: The Animated Series is a fantastic, old-school, side-scrolling beat ‘em up based on the classic 80’s TV series.

Made by ZVitor (creator of Marvel Infinity War and Justice League Unlimited), this OpenBOR-powered brawler features all six of the show’s heroes as playable characters: Hank, Bobby, Sheila, Presto, Diana, & Eric, each with their own unique skills and combat styles. There are four unlockable characters: Bruenor, Strongheart, Warduke, Venger.

All the characters, enemies and settings from the show are faithfully recreated, but the game actually goes even further with some innovative new additions. Perhaps most impressive is the fact that you can instantly switch between characters at the touch of a button – so you don’t have to stick with just one character until your credit is used up. Not only does that add a nice bit of variety, it allows you to make use of different characters' skills for different situations. There's also a light RPG element to the game, as you collect upgrades and level up.

Overall, the vibrant visuals, big bosses, challenging gameplay and varied settings make Dungeons & Dragons: The Animated Series a must-play.

216844.overview:
Enter Double Dragon AKA Double Dragon: Enter Evil Forces Expand is a game created in 2013. However, it is one of the best works for OpenBoR that simulates 8-bit systems. The graphics and animation are very reminiscent of the old Nintendo consoles.Simple decorations, which, however, look great in the overall look. 

  Enter Double Dragon AKA Double Dragon: Enter Evil Forces Expand  uses the OpenBoR engine to power its models, which means that the dynamics and gameplay are modern and attractive. The figures move at a game pace that will allow you to immerse yourself in this beat 'em up world. At your disposal are three characters to play with. You can choose Billy Lee, Jimmy Lee or Bimmy, who is a new character for the saga. The three characters have similar techniques for fighting. Particularly attractive is Jimmy, who has some pretty spectacular grips.

  The game looks very good and the synchronization between the elements is excellent, the dynamics are high quality and the matches are fascinating. We can mention that it is quite short and you will want to play more.

  Two more levels have been added to the game, probably a demo for the next fuller version. They are quite interesting and completely new plots.

  Enter Double Dragon AKA Double Dragon: Enter Evil Forces Expand the game  has been produced by OpenBoR society and Die in Fire

446531.overview: This OpenBOR mod is based on the famous Double Dragon 1 and 2 arcades. It is based on one of the latest versions of OpenBor, a modified version of the engine that adds new functionalities, such as more specials per character, the possibility of placing lethal ground (pits, rivers, etc...), characters that cannot be keyed, etc... In addition to having an unbeatable appearance, as it is based on the graphics of the original arcade games, it has no less than 10 different game modes, with different levels , characters and bosses in them, three fighting modes with different moves and specials for Billy and Jimmy, unpublished characters, levels that only appeared in certain versions of some consoles, classic traps from the series such as statues or spears, a high difficulty but not desperate (very well measured), etc...

453303.overview:
Nostalgia Warriors present a combined mix of the Double Dragon story. Rescue, avenge, and ultimately save Marion... and possibly the world in a post apocalyptic setting.

Double Dragon ReMix contains the first trilogy of the NES version.

Double Dragon:
The game takes place in a post-apocalyptic New York, five years after a nuclear war. Control over the city hold various criminal gangs.

One day, Black Warriors bandits kidnap Marian, Billy's girlfriend.

Double Dragon II: The Revenge:
The game begins with the assassination of Marian of the original Double Dragon leader of the Black Warriors. Billy and Jimmy Lee go to take revenge.

Double Dragon III: The Rosetta Stone
The final part of the legendary trilogy of Double Dragon. A year after the events of Double Dragon II, Marian is abducted again. At the same time, a certain Hiruko appears, who tells the brothers that Marian will be released if the brothers get 3 Rosetta stones and go with them to Egypt. And Lee's brothers have no choice but to follow this advice.

455316.overview: DC Task Force is a game where you explore the DC universe, visiting classic cities and planets, assembling your own Justice League team and recruiting members to protect planet Earth from an alien invasion. This campaign can be completed in just over an hour, but would require at least 7 hours to explore the entire universe and recruit all possible characters.
